description: This is a Perl script used for downloading files, handling multiple mirrors, verifying hashes, and managing download tools.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and configuration, returning an array of mirror URLs.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks the availability of a command in the system path.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command (md5 or sha256) based on the hash length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specified download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) is available and its version matches expectations.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects an appropriate download tool based on availability and user configuration.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command to download files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the download process from local or remote sources, verifying hashes, and handling errors.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files related to downloads.
